feature: AI-search visibility (ChatGPT Search, Claude web search, Gemini)
goal: Raise the probability that ChatGPT Search, Claude web search and Gemini cite or accurately recommend LenAqar for Egyptian resale property questions in the areas it serves, and that this produces qualified buy/sell inquiries.
rules: Update this file at the end of every step: item status, PR, evidence, next_step, history.
After an owner merge: verify Vercel githubCommitSha = merge SHA, run scripts/seo-health.mjs on production (0 FAIL), then start next_step without waiting.
Labels: V verified (evidence + date), S supplied but unverified, I inaccessible, H hypothesis.
Unavailable metrics are 'unknown', never 0. Direct traffic is never AI traffic. whatsapp_click is an interaction, not a lead.
No promise of inclusion, ranking, citation or training outcome. No causation claims.
Never invent prices, fees or facts; every number has a source and date. Never mark a price verified from updatedAt or the current date.
Isolated worktree off origin/main, one small PR per step, owner merges. No merge or deploy by the assistant.
Outreach is drafted only, never sent. Paid tools and account changes need owner approval.
English content only with audience evidence (B15 gate).
